why: A grand project at the idea stage: an interactive engine for mnemonic techniques and the memory kingdom they build - kept so it is not forgotten.
The conveyor every project leans on to reach a machine: one declaration, signed Arch and Alpine repositories, called not copied.
The first grand view of the commons: Linux phones as good as Android.
A grand project on the periphery: software as a content-addressed graph of definitions in place of files, packages and versions - recorded whole, to be ready when the old ways get in the way enough.
